definitions.error_outcome: A recorded candidate error is a completed scenario outcome, not a passing scenario or an infrastructure error.
definitions.private_behavior_signatures: A distinct vector of pass/fail results on that project/stage private suite; this does not measure semantic source diversity beyond tested inputs.
definitions.probe_discrimination_by_phase: Counts distinct generated inputs whose pass/fail result differs between at least two sources within at least one pool of this phase. It is a union across pools, not a sum of pool/probe observations. Eligible comparison includes original source eligibility and mandatory public pass.

interpretation: Every frozen pool has the same private case passes, private-perfect status and requirement coverage under all four declared selectors in both scopes. Generated evidence changes source choice in two calendar stage-runs and removes additional generated-test failures without improving private scores.

Every final pool with an eligible public-passing private-perfect source selected one. All defined actual same-pool requirement regrets are zero; undefined cases remain null. This isolates no demonstrated private-quality selection bottleneck in these pools.

Private-perfect availability rose from 7 initial pools to 9 final pools; this is descriptive repair/pool evolution, not a randomized causal repair effect. Final repaired sources must not be credited to initial selectors.

Independent candidate failure profiles were more diverse on calendar; graph included one independent initial pool whose four distinct source strings all failed all private scenarios. String diversity alone is insufficient.

Pooled reviewer evidence detects every fault family found by scouts, but own-history complementarity exists. Model, context and generation opportunities differ, so this is not a causal comparison of scout and reviewer roles.
168 probe/stage observations represent 118 distinct project/input identities. Fault families and inherited probes recur across stages; neither sum is an independent sample.

Pooled evidence was unavailable to live selectors. Own-history reviewer evidence applied to initial pools may also have been generated after repair and review. Best-ever source ceilings span policies and attempts and are diagnostic only.

Generated probes are oracle-admitted; their labels and evidence utility do not establish unsupervised specification discovery. Two maintained synthetic applications and stage reachability limit generalization. No Elo or causal gossip-versus-orchestrator superiority claim is supported.

Within-pool eligible discrimination requires at least two public-passing eligible sources: calendar has 3/5 comparable stage-0 pools and 4/5 stage-1 pools in each phase; graph stage 0 has none in either phase, so its zero cannot measure probe weakness. Graph stage 1 has only one comparable pool (independent-four-0); its 5-to-9 rise must not be generalized to the singleton anchor or unreached trajectories.
sample_size_warning: 15,532 outcomes and 272 derived counterfactual selections are not independent project observations. Primary cohort: 10 trajectories across 2 applications; 17 reached stage-run pools.
scope: Independent arithmetic and source-artifact reconciliation; no API, Docker, candidate execution, original audit rerun, or scientific source edits.
